concerns.text: FR-004 mentions “statistically significant threshold above the mean of a null distribution” but does not specify a concrete significance level (e.g., p < 0.05) or the number of permutations to generate the null distribution, making the requirement unmeasurable.

FR-006 requires “multiple bootstrap resampling iterations” without stating how many iterations are needed, which bootstrap statistic is used, or what p‑value cutoff defines significance; this prevents a deterministic test.

FR-008 calls for validation against “published therapy response signatures” but does not name the specific signature set, the statistical test, nor the significance threshold, leaving the acceptance condition vague.

SC-001 states the pipeline must run on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ~7 GB RAM, ≤6 h) but does not describe how the runtime and memory usage will be measured (e.g., wall‑clock timer, resource‑monitoring tool), so the criterion is not directly testable.

SC-005 requires the datasets to contain “PD‑1 expression, metabolic markers, exhaustion signatures, and therapy response labels” but does not define a verification procedure (e.g., schema check or marker list) to confirm their presence.
